headline: Dead Lands Flares With Rapid Base Contests as Stonecradle Clashes Mount
war_summary: Direct base combat has shifted squarely to the Dead Lands over the past two hours, where three rapid strategic transitions unfolded around Callahan's Gate, claiming nearly a thousand casualties as Warden losses outpaced Colonial fallings two to one. Meanwhile, the violent base exchanges previously wracking the Weathered Expanse and Stlican Shelf have paused, though Weathered Expanse continues to bleed heavily with over seven hundred combined casualties in the latest two-hour interval. In Stonecradle, frontline intensity has spiked sharply; while strategic installations held firm, casualty rates surged over the last hour to claim nearly a thousand dead across two hours. Further west, Nevish Line remains a punishing meatgrinder logging over five hundred casualties in two hours despite cooling trends, while Linn of Mercy sustains active fighting with Warden casualties accelerating. Other sectors, including Mooring County and the maritime outposts of Fisherman's Row and Godcrofts, have settled into quiet standoffs with negligible recent casualties and no fresh territorial change.
